column3: Content Security Policy header not set
Server leaks version information via the Server header
Strict-Transport-Security: TLS (and HSTS) terminate at the ingress, not in the pod
Storable and cacheable content: responses send Cache-Control: no-store
Insufficient site isolation (COEP/COOP): not relevant for a JSON API
ZAP is out of date: the image is pinned by digest on purpose
